text.p: - Galenica, the largest Swiss pharmaceutical distributor, said it is looking for a buyer for its minority share in the recently launched direct drug distribution group Medirect.
- Swiss telecom consortium DIAX chose U.S. group SBC Communications of Texas, a "Baby Bell" company, as its expert partner for new telephone venture set to compete with state Swiss Telecom from 1998.
- The Swiss government presented detailed plans to parliament for its controversial proposal to wipe out "mad cow" disease BSE in Switzerland by slaughtering some 230,000 cows through 1999.
- Swiss apprentenship programs costs between 1.5 and 1.8 million Swiss francs per year, a study reported.
- Swissair plans to axe 66 jobs in France due to restructuring measures. At the same time, the Swiss national airline will create 30 new jobs in France.
- The Swiss upper house of parliament allocated some 130 Swiss francs to plan the Expo 2001, a nation-wide exhibition in the year 2001.
